question: How many miles driven autonomously will Tesla Robotaxi have driven as of December 1, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Robotaxi Stats read Tesla's live counter at 4.81M on Nov 9 3:20 AM PT; confirmed 3.1M thru Oct 18. Counter readings (>3.3M Oct 21, >3.4M ~Oct 24, 4.81M Nov 9) imply a near-constant ~80-88k mi/day extrapolation, consistent with the confirmed 550k-mile week of Oct 12-18. Continuing at that pace for ~22.5 days to Dec 1 adds ~1.8M -> ~6.6-6.7M. Upside: actual pace is higher (~700k/wk as of Oct 31, growing ~17-20%/wk, Cybercab additions in Nov); a new safety report could recalibrate the counter to a higher base and pace (7-8M+). Downside: a downward recalibration or an early-day snapshot. No human prediction market found (the Manifold candidate asks about a level-4 launch in summer 2025, not miles).

- Tesla Robotaxi Safety Report (published Oct 21, 2026): 3.1M driverless miles Jan 22-Oct 18, 2026 (Austin 2.118M, Dallas 0.608M, Houston 0.226M, Orlando 61k, Tampa 53k, Miami 46k) (dockduty.com, notateslaapp).
- Live counter >3.3M on Oct 21 (Not a Tesla App); >3.4M around Oct 23-24 (press reports).
- Implied counter pace: Oct 21->Nov 9 ~79k/day; Oct 24->Nov 9 ~88k/day; confirmed week Oct 12-18 = ~550k miles (~79k/day) (NextBigFuture). The counter appears to extrapolate the last reported pace.
- NextBigFuture (late Oct): ~4.1M unsupervised miles as of Oct 31; ~700k miles/week, growing 17-20%/week; 1,325 unsupervised vehicles in TX+FL; 300 Cybercabs each planned for Dallas and Houston in November; projects ~2M miles/week by late Nov (advocate source, optimistic).
- Earlier milestones: 1M unsupervised miles announced Sep 3, 2026 (Electrek); ~2M by end of Q3 2026.
- Texas DMV registry: 1,302 Tesla vehicles on Nov 10 (robotaxistats).
- Status quo: counter keeps rising at ~80-88k/day -> roughly 6.6-6.7M by late Dec 1. A new safety report before Dec 1 could reset the counter base and pace (direction uncertain; actual activity is likely above the counter pace).
- Resolves off the robotaxistats.com snapshot timestamped Dec 1, 2026 PST (fallback: tesla.com/robotaxi), in millions.
- Event window: point reading on Dec 1, 2026 (PST); as of Nov 11 21:00 UTC, ~20 days remain (about 2.5 days elapsed since the last known reading of Nov 9).
- Searched, could not find: any counter reading after Nov 9; Tesla's safety-report update cadence; tesla.com/robotaxi page (403).
- No human prediction market found on this quantity.
calls.reference_class: Linear extrapolation of Tesla's live-counter pace (fixed rate from the last safety-report period) over the remaining horizon

calls.reasoning: Robotaxi Stats read Tesla's live counter at 4,806,465 miles on Nov 9 at about 3:20 AM PT. Earlier readings were >3.3M on Oct 21 and ~4.1M around Oct 31/Nov 1. Those imply the counter's pace rose from ~79k/day to ~88k/day, so it seems to be refreshed upward slowly. It is not growing at the 17-20%/week NextBigFuture claims. About 22.9 days remain to the end of Dec 1 PST. Flat pace gives ~6.7-6.85M. Modest growth from adding Cybercabs and expanding the Austin area points to ~6.9-7.1M. A new safety report could rebase the counter higher or lower. No human prediction market matches: the Manifold candidate asks about an L4 launch in summer 2025 and says nothing about miles.
calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the anchor: 4.806M on Nov 9 at 3:20 PT, with a counter pace of ~80-90k/day. Their gaps are almost all judgment calls: how much the pace grows, and how heavily to weight NBF's optimistic claims. Run 2's 88k/day from Nov 1 and Run 1's 79k/day from Oct 21 are consistent once you allow that the pace rose over time, so the factual inputs fit together. One factual point stays unsettled: whether the counter's pace updates continuously or only when a safety report comes out. I can't confirm that without web access, so I priced both. The observed growth in pace (~10% over about 2 weeks) supports a median a little above flat extrapolation, about 6.9M. I put little weight on NBF's figure of 2M miles/week, because counter readings so far don't show that kind of acceleration. Going below 5M would take a collapse or a large downward rebase, so that tail is tiny.

disagreements.verdict: Both are right over different windows. The pace rose from ~79k/day (from Oct 21) to ~88k/day (Nov 1-9).
